title: Little Firefly's Song
subtitle: Pip's theme — a tiny spark that never gives up
lyrics: Oh forest, tall and whispering green,
Can you hear my tiny voice tonight?
I'm just a spark, a little gleam,
But I still fill the dark with light.
Dear moon, so high and silver-round,
You watch me dance from far away.
Even when the night feels heavy,
You never look the other way.
Chorus
I will glow, I will glow, I will never give up,
Happiness lives in this little cup
Of light I carry in my heart.
When the wind is strong and the path is long,
I keep on shining, I keep on strong.
I will glow, I will glow, I will never give up.
The trees lean in and the leaves all hush,
The crickets pause to hear me sing.
I tell them joy is not a race,
It's the tiny light I bring.
The moon just smiles her quiet smile,
And paints the world in silver-blue.
She says, “Keep going, little one—
The dark was made for you.”
Chorus
I will glow, I will glow, I will never give up,
Happiness lives in this little cup
Of light I carry in my heart.
When the wind is strong and the path is long,
I keep on shining, I keep on strong.
I will glow, I will glow, I will never give up.
So forest, hold me in your arms,
And moon, keep watching from above.
I'll twinkle on through every night
With happiness and love.
I will glow…
I will glow…
I will never give up.
placement: Soft verse in Chapter 1; chorus under the fail montage; full song at the finale.

title: Luma's Sad Song
subtitle: When the moon feels dark and forgotten
lyrics: I used to silver every street,
I used to hush the world to sleep.
Now I'm a shadow, soft and gray—
A quiet light that slipped away.
The children wait. I hear them sigh.
I want to shine. I don't know why
My glow went small, my glow went still…
I hang alone above the hill.
Chorus
I'm dark tonight, I'm dark tonight,
A moon without her borrowed light.
If someone sees me as I am—
Not bright, just me—please understand:
I'm dark tonight, I'm dark tonight,
But I am still the moon, all right.
I watched the sparks and stars go by.
They tried to paint me in the sky.
Their kindness landed, soft and true…
But none of them could make me new.
A tiny voice keeps calling near—
A little glow that stays right here.
She doesn't fix me like a lamp…
She sits with me inside the damp.
Chorus
I'm dark tonight, I'm dark tonight,
A moon without her borrowed light.
If someone sees me as I am—
Not bright, just me—please understand:
I'm dark tonight, I'm dark tonight,
But I am still the moon, all right.
Maybe the dark is not the end.
Maybe it means I need a friend.
Until my silver finds its way…
I'll hold this night. I'll wait. I'll stay.
I'm dark tonight…
I'm dark tonight…
But I am still the moon.
placement: When Pip first finds dark Luma (Chapter 5). Soft reprise under failed helps.

title: When the Fairy Gets Sad
subtitle: A song the forest animals sing to Pip
lyrics: Owl in the oak, soft and low:
Little fairy, dry your eyes.
The night is big, but you are not alone—
We are here beneath these skies.
Rabbit in the clover, gentle and small:
If your wings feel heavy tonight,
Rest them here on the mossy ground.
We'll keep you safe till morning light.
Chorus
Don't dim your glow, don't hide your spark,
The forest loves you in the dark.
When your heart feels small and blue,
We will sing until you're you.
Don't give up, little shining one—
The moon is watching, the night isn't done.
Deer by the stream, quiet and kind:
Even stars get tired sometimes.
They still come back and light the way.
You can too, in your own time.
Frog on the lily, warm and true:
Sadness visits, then it goes.
We will croak and hop and stay
Until your little light grows.
Chorus
Don't dim your glow, don't hide your spark,
The forest loves you in the dark.
When your heart feels small and blue,
We will sing until you're you.
Don't give up, little shining one—
The moon is watching, the night isn't done.
All the animals together:
So close your eyes if you need to rest.
We'll hum the trees and hold you tight.
Tomorrow the sun will find you again—
And so will we, with all our light.
Don't dim your glow…
Don't hide your spark…
We are here.
You are loved.
Don't give up.
placement: Comfort number when Pip feels her spark is too small.
